parts:

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: Path fitting Error
parts:
Joshin,
  Notice the near zero R-square values for reli1 to reli4.  That suggests that these variables have nothing in common and do not serve as indicators of the same latent variable.  To test this out, look at the correlation matrix for your data.  Then use the itemanal() function in the rela package to obtain rest-score correlations and R-squares.  (Note that itemanal() has a quirk that it requires a matrix with names.  Converting a data frame to a matrix will satisfy this requirement.)

require(rela)
round(cor(wddata),3)
itemanal(as.matrix(wddata[c('reli1', 'reli2', 'reli3', 'reli4')]))

If these results confirm the idea that the four variables are not related to one another, then consider dropping the RelAf latent variable and allowing them to have direct effects on wlb.

Keith
